positioning.title: Mathematics, Algorithms & AI
positioning.statement: 这里记录数学、算法与 AI 中值得反复理解的问题：结论依赖怎样的结构，方法为何有效，又在什么条件下失效。

principles.label: STRUCTURE
principles.title: 数学澄清结构
principles.desc: 从定义、假设与推导中找出真正决定结论的部分。

en.label: STRUCTURE
en.title: Mathematics clarifies structure
en.desc: Use definitions, assumptions, and derivations to identify what determines a result.

principles.label: MECHANISM
principles.title: 算法解释过程
principles.desc: 关注不变量、信息流与计算步骤，而不只给出结果。

en.label: MECHANISM
en.title: Algorithms explain the process
en.desc: Follow invariants, information flow, and computational steps, beyond the final result.

principles.label: BOUNDARY
principles.title: 核验标出边界
principles.desc: 用反例、实验与来源说明结论何时成立、何时失效。

en.label: BOUNDARY
en.title: Verification marks the limits
en.desc: Use counterexamples, experiments, and sources to show when a result holds and when it fails.

en.title: Mathematics, Algorithms & AI
en.statement: Questions in mathematics, algorithms, and AI worth revisiting: which structures support a result, why a method works, and when it fails.

collections.title: 概率、信息与集中
collections.question: 概率质量如何在高维空间中组织起来？
collections.desc: 从典型集出发，连接集中现象、信息量与高维几何。

en.title: Probability, information, and concentration
en.question: How is probability mass organized in high-dimensional spaces?
en.desc: Start with typical sets to connect concentration, information, and high-dimensional geometry.

collections.title: 策略优化
collections.question: 策略梯度究竟在优化什么，又受什么分布约束？
collections.desc: 从目标、梯度估计和覆盖分布理解强化学习中的优化结构。

en.title: Policy optimization
en.question: What does policy gradient actually optimize, and which distributions constrain it?
en.desc: Understand the optimization structure of reinforcement learning through objectives, gradient estimation, and distributional coverage.

collections.title: 序列决策与探索
collections.question: 单步随机性为何不足以保证真正的信息被观察？
collections.desc: 从状态访问、到达事件与轨迹分布理解强化学习中的深度探索。

en.title: Sequential decision-making and exploration
en.question: Why is randomness at each step insufficient to guarantee informative observations?
en.desc: Understand deep exploration in reinforcement learning through state visitation, hitting events, and trajectory distributions.

collections.title: 生成模型与世界模型
collections.question: 学习系统如何形成可预测、可用而不塌缩的表示？
collections.desc: 从潜变量建模到 latent prediction，比较目标函数与表示几何。

en.title: Generative models and world models
en.question: How can learning systems form predictable, useful representations that do not collapse?
en.desc: From latent-variable modeling to latent prediction, compare objectives and representation geometry.

entries.title: Typical Set：高维空间中的概率集中
entries.desc: 概率质量为什么不在密度最高的点，而会落在高维空间中的薄壳上？

en.title: Typical sets: probability concentration in high dimensions
en.desc: Why does probability mass concentrate on a thin shell in high dimensions, away from the point of highest density?

entries.title: Policy Gradient 的优化视角
entries.desc: 从目标函数、梯度估计、方差与步长选择建立一条连续的优化主线。

en.title: Policy gradient through the lens of optimization
en.desc: Trace a connected optimization argument through objectives, gradient estimation, variance, and step-size selection.

entries.title: 从 Bandit 到 RL：Deep Exploration 为何必要
entries.desc: 固定单步动作边缘分布后，路径事件概率为何仍能从 p^N 变为 p？

en.title: Why random actions are not enough
en.desc: With each step's marginal action distribution fixed, why can a path event's probability still change from p^N to p?

entries.title: VAE 与 ELBO
entries.desc: 从潜变量模型与变分下界理解生成模型的基本优化对象。

en.title: VAE and ELBO
en.desc: Use latent-variable models and variational lower bounds to understand the basic optimization objective of generative models.

entries.title: LeWorldModel / SIGReg：为什么不会塌缩？
entries.desc: 连接 latent prediction、表示塌缩与 SIGReg，辨认机制真正依赖的条件。

en.title: LeWorldModel / SIGReg: why doesn't it collapse?
en.desc: Connect latent prediction, representation collapse, and SIGReg to identify the conditions the mechanism actually needs.
